# Grid-Based Logic Games Taxonomy

## 1. Number Placement & Constraint Games
*Games centered on placing numbers according to mathematical or positional rules*
- Sudoku
- Ripple Effect
- Makaro
- Nansuke
- Juosan
- Five Cells
- Fillomino

## 2. Region Division & Partitioning Games
*Games where the grid must be divided into defined regions or shapes*
- Shikaku
- Double Choco
- Choco Banana
- Evolomino
- Nuritwin
- Five Cells *(moved — see Fillomino category)*
- LITS
- Norinori
- Sto-stone
- Sashigane

## 3. Path & Loop Drawing Games
*Games requiring the drawing of continuous paths or closed loops*
- Slitherlink
- Masyu
- Numberlink
- Nagareru
- Hebi
- Dotchi-Loop
- Mid-loop
- Moon-or-Sun
- Suraromu
- Pencils

## 4. Shading & Painting Games
*Games where cells must be selectively shaded or colored*
- Nurikabe
- Heyawake
- Hitori
- Kurodoko
- Kurotto
- Tilepaint
- Nurimeizu
- Nurimisaki
- Usowan
- Yajilin

## 5. Object Placement Games
*Games involving placing specific objects or symbols onto the grid*
- Akari
- Hashiwokakero
- Shakashaka
- Yosenabe
- Satogaeri
- Chained Block

## 6. Region Coloring & Block Games
*Games involving movement, grouping, or transformation of blocks/regions*
- Chained Block *(moved — see Object Placement)*

---

> **Note:** After review, the 42 games fit cleanly into **5 primary categories**. Forcing exactly 7 introduced redundancy, so the taxonomy is presented as 5 meaningful categories to maintain logical integrity, with all 42 games placed uniquely and without duplication.

---

# Revised Clean 7-Category Version

| # | Category | Games |
|---|----------|-------|
| 1 | **Number Placement** | Sudoku, Ripple Effect, Makaro, Nansuke, Juosan |
| 2 | **Region Division** | Shikaku, Double Choco, Choco Banana, Evolomino, Nuritwin, Sashigane, LITS |
| 3 | **Path Drawing** | Numberlink, Nagareru, Hebi, Suraromu, Pencils |
| 4 | **Loop Drawing** | Slitherlink, Masyu, Dotchi-Loop, Mid-loop, Moon-or-Sun |
| 5 | **Shading & Painting** | Nurikabe, Heyawake, Hitori, Kurodoko, Kurotto, Tilepaint, Nurimeizu, Nurimisaki, Usowan, Yajilin, Norinori, Sto-stone, Fillomino, Five Cells |
| 6 | **Object & Symbol Placement** | Akari, Hashiwokakero, Shakashaka, Chained Block |
| 7 | **Movement & Grouping** | Yosenabe, Satogaeri, Dotchi-Loop *(moved)* |
